boundaries: The retained TriggerGroup and ActionSelector getters/setters create a missing Trigger Control application 202, exact non-255 trigger groups, and exact nonnegative action levels through the original nonblank paths.
The automatic group path admits the fresh CBusNetwork default bAdd=true; it does not replay a prior Toolkit process session in which a user declined an unrelated auto-add prompt.

The separate interactive SceneManager Add buttons enter accepted dialogs. The action dialog scans first-free 0..254 and seeds editable Level N; that dialog was not executed or implemented because it does not share the automatic exact-address path.

DYNAMIC/FONT project-image and ICON DLTP image presence is not derivable from DBGETXML and is rejected when an existing level consumes it; a created level uses only the source-established four blank variants.

DBADDSAFE/DBSETSAFE, PP SAVE and PROJECT SAVE are separate operations. A retained backup is created before metadata mutation, rollback is automatic only before the first applicable persistence save starts, and no uncertain save is retried.
The optional native gate requires a disposable closed project and explicit environment opt-in. It was not enabled for this recorded acceptance.
No physical unit or house C-Bus network was opened or programmed.
